status: Frozen before new-corpus execution; exploratory extension, not a preregistration
question: Does expansion from 85 archived normal-parent transcripts to GENCODE50 mature transcripts change sequence-risk descriptors and split-choice rankings for the frozen 215-design/43-junction catalogue?

new_source.sha256: Measured at execution; provider MD5 verified before scan

methods.orientation: Search target RNA 5'-3' (DNA alphabet), the reverse complement of each 16nt ASO; no reverse-complement scan of mature transcript records
methods.architecture: Proposed 5LNA-6DNA-5LNA; full DNA gap at zero-based target positions 5:11
methods.primary: Exact maximum contiguous perfect tract that includes all six core bases in any complete unambiguous 16nt window; zero means no complete-core match
methods.secondary: Minimum full-16nt Hamming distance across all complete unambiguous windows, exact at distance0..3; otherwise report null and lower bound4 Union intervals also use frozen archived exact distances as upper bounds: archived4 plus all new>=4 proves exact4; archived5 plus all new>=4 yields[4,5].
methods.ranking: Within each five-split junction, minimize primary maximum, then maximize minimum Hamming. Resolve final co-winners if all primary intervals are exact, the primary winner is unique, or one candidate's lower bound exceeds every rival's upper bound; otherwise retain unresolved status.
strata: GENCODE records with exact gene symbol in EWSR1,TAF15,TCF12,FUS,TFG,NR4A3,PGR
methods.union: Retain archived parent transcripts and all GENCODE records. Do not subtract normal-parent or exact matches.
methods.duplicates: Keep transcript aliases, patch/haplotype records and repeated windows. Counts denote record-window occurrences; extrema and per-junction choices are not sample estimates.
methods.ambiguity: Uppercase and U->T; skip windows containing any other base; never join FASTA records
methods.witnesses: First20 witnesses in input-record and coordinate order for each best metric and stratum; total count and gene set uncapped

endpoints: Design count with increased primary maximum
Design count with smaller minimum Hamming
Primary and final choice changes for43 target junctions
acceptance: Independent exhaustive-window oracle checks extrema, counts, witnesses, boundaries and input failures
Reproduce all220 archived gap values and bounded Hamming values before fetching new corpus
Verify fixed source hashes and provider byte count/MD5
Require union monotonicity, complete design coverage and no censored value relabeled as exact
Independently inspect changed choices and source witnesses before manuscript claims
limits: Mature reference annotation; not expression, pre-mRNA, genome-wide, variant-personalized or tissue-specific coverage
No cleavage, potency, delivery, accessibility or clinical safety conclusion
Post hoc corpus-extension sensitivity, no fitted cutoff or new target selection against outcomes
stop: Produce reproducible source receipts, full per-design descriptors, ranking differences and bounded witnesses; stop on hash, oracle, baseline, headroom or time failure.
